parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true — `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` (package Artwork) and `MetadataMockWebSession` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift` (package Metadata). Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are. Although the two types share `requestedURLs:[URL]` and a `responses` field, they differ in the response map type (`[Data]` vs `[String: Data]`), reflecting legitimately different stubbing needs for their respective test suites. Extracting a generic shared mock would couple the Artwork and Metadata test targets together without meaningful benefit.
